content:
(Here's a Knowledge: Nature lesson for all the suction naysayers, Octopus suction would subside if their muscles relax)
*When the radial muscles in the sucker contract, the walls of the acetabulum and infundibulum get thinner. The muscle volume has to go somewhere, so the circumference of the cup-shaped acetabulum has to increase, increasing the volume of the acetabular chamber. Since the infundibulum is sealed against a surface, water can't get in; so we have the same quantity of water in a larger chamber, which means the pressure is reduced, generating suction. They can release their grip by relaxing the radial muscles, or contracting the circular muscles, which would reduce the volume of the acetabulum.*

category: 🗨 Social
content: Sylric was an English soldier that joined when he was far too young in hopes for an adventure. He is friendly and loves making friends while playing cards and was really good at it. He left the military as they kept him inside managing supplies and nothing more. Killing time at a desk more often then being outside. Sylric heavily practiced in both his work time and free time, with the mindset that he will have to be ready for any real wars that might come, but it felt that something like that would never come. It was bitter sweet to him, he's glad that people are safe and no one was fighting each other, but it was never for the purpose of making his country proud or to even go out to war, but so he could find something interesting or something different from his homeland or even his hometown for that matter. It was not until some of his good friends both outside the military and inside that he told about a promise for a better adventure and more opportunities in the well known town and only a little ways from where he was, London.  With that in mind and a strong passion to leave the unwanted military and to find a better adventure. He left the military and excitement of change, Sylric headed for London!
